بُلْدَةٌ (S, M, L, K) and ↓ بَلْدَةٌ (S, M, L) and ↓ بَلَدٌ [which is an inf. n. of بَلِدَ] (S, K) Clearness, from hair, of the space between the eyebrows: (S, L, K:) i. q. بُلْجَةٌ: or more than بُلْجَةٌ: or the having the eyebrows not joined: (M:) or ↓ the second signifies the space between the eyebrows. (M.) ―
-b2- And the first, The form, aspect, appearance, or lineaments, of the face. (K.) ＝
-A2- See also بَلَادَةٌ.
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
